tagline.en: The original Depth Anything — a robust monocular depth estimator that predicts relative depth from a single image.
tagline.zh: 初代 Depth Anything——稳健的单目深度估计器,从单张图像预测相对深度。

en: Depth Anything V1 is a widely-adopted foundation model for monocular depth estimation: from one ordinary image it predicts a dense depth map. It became popular for being robust across diverse scenes without per-scene tuning.

It's a ViT-based model offered in small, base and large sizes, so you can trade accuracy against speed and memory. In this profile it produces relative depth and geometry artifacts you can export for downstream use.
In WorldFoundry, Depth Anything V1 runs through the in-tree depth pipeline: feed it an image and it returns a depth map and geometry output that later 3D/4D stages can build on.
zh: Depth Anything V1 是被广泛采用的单目深度估计基础模型:从一张普通图像预测出稠密深度图。它因在各种场景下无需逐场景调参即可稳健工作而广受欢迎。
它是基于 ViT 的模型,提供 small、base、large 三种规模,便于你在精度与速度、显存之间权衡。在该配置下,它产出相对深度和几何产物,可导出供下游使用。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Depth Anything V1 通过内置深度 pipeline 运行:给它一张图像,它就会返回可供后续 3D、4D 环节使用的深度图与几何输出。

whenToUse.en: A solid default when you need relative monocular depth from single images and want a well-tested, general-purpose estimator to feed geometry into a 3D/4D workflow.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从单张图像获得相对单目深度,并想要一个经过充分检验的通用估计器为 3D/4D 工作流提供几何输入时,它是可靠的默认选择。

notFor.en: It predicts relative depth rather than calibrated metric distances, so it's not the pick when you need absolute metric measurements. Newer Depth Anything versions may give sharper results.
notFor.zh: 它预测的是相对深度而非标定的度量距离,因此当你需要绝对度量测量时并不适用。更新的 Depth Anything 版本可能带来更清晰的结果。

en: Robust monocular depth from a single image
ViT-based, available in small / base / large sizes
Exports relative depth and geometry artifacts
zh: 从单张图像获得稳健的单目深度
基于 ViT,提供 small / base / large 三种规模
导出相对深度与几何产物
